system.description:
When you bark an order or warning, roll +CHA: on a 7+, they must choose 1:

  • Do what you say
  • Dig in/take cover/flee
  • Attack you

On a 10+, you can sense which one they're about to do and act first if you like; gain advantage if you do.

success.value: They must choose 1 (do what you say, dig in/take cover/flee, or attack you), and you sense which one they're about to do: act first if you like, and gain advantage if you do.

partial.value: They must choose 1: do what you say, dig in/take cover/flee, or attack you.
